verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships AI features (Neo, the MCP server, AI-assisted docs) and a hosted Pulumi Cloud, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence describes an AI-training data policy, an opt-out control, or a no-training guarantee. Self-hosting and DIY state backends keep data out of Pulumi Cloud, but they do not address AI model training.
